caveats: Discontinued or closed to new customers, confirmed on the live site 2026-09-29. Pricing page unchanged: $150/month per runner, unlimited minutes, 15% annual (12-month) / 50% nonprofit. Home page still says 'Try Cirrus Runners for free' and shows the calculator, but the official Cirrus Labs announcement (cirruslabs.org, 2026-04-07) says no new customers; Cirrus CI shut down 2026
GitHub Actions runners only; a runner slot runs one job at a time, so 50 concurrent jobs need 50 slots = $7,500/month regardless of hours.
Engine encodes it as always-on: only priced for always-on instances; for bursty CI the flat fee per concurrency slot is what you pay.
Low-priority tasks can queue behind the subscription's concurrency. No Windows.
Cirrus Labs joined OpenAI (announced 2026-04-07); Cirrus Runners no longer accepts new customers, existing customers are served through their contract periods. The pricing page is stale marketing.

fleet.verification: Subscription purchase; special KYC requirements not published.
fleet.tiers: Buy a subscription per concurrent runner; change subscription in pricing page or by email to sales.
fleet.notes: Concurrency follows purchased runner quantity, so no universal new-account instance count. Unlimited minutes is not unlimited concurrent machines. Trial allowance and maximum self-serve quantity not established.

status: closed to new customers; existing contracts served until they end

snapshot_auto.quote: Every job is executed in a reproducible isolated environment which is completely destroyed after the job is finished.
snapshot_auto.note: Single-use VM per GitHub Actions job; nothing is saved when it ends.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Cirrus Runners execute each workflow job in a single use virtual machine.
snapshot_on_demand.note: No snapshot/checkpoint API or UI; runners are ephemeral and boot only from Cirrus-provided images (ghcr.io/cirruslabs/*), not user snapshots.

harness_api.quote: In order for Cirrus Runners to be used by your GitHub Actions workflow jobs, specify a desired image in the runs-on property:
harness_api.note: GitHub Actions runner service only; jobs are driven by GitHub Actions workflows, no agent-harness API.

guest_firewall.note: Full VMs (macOS on Tart/Apple Virtualization, Linux on KVM) with passwordless sudo, so pf/iptables/nftables inside the VM should work. Derived, not documented.

secret_proxy.note: No Cirrus secret feature; secrets are GitHub Actions secrets exposed to job steps as env vars/inputs inside the VM.

volume_attach.quote: Each Cirrus Runner you subscribe to comes with 10GB of storage space. Files in this storage are automatically deleted after 100 days to make room for new ones.
volume_attach.note: Only a fixed per-class local disk (50-400 GB) plus the Omni Cache HTTP cache storage (GitHub Actions cache v2 / Bazel / Gradle / Docker layer cache protocols, served by a local sidecar). No attachable volumes.

volume_shared.quote: Omni Cache is a local sidecar cache server that supports the GitHub Actions cache v2 protocol and build system protocols like Bazel.
volume_shared.note: The cache storage is shared across repositories but accessed via cache protocols, not mounted as a shared filesystem.
